messages:
Maya: Quick PSA — spotted a 'ghost' anchor in staging preview for runtime guide. Link goes to top of page instead of section. repro: open https://staging.docs.redwood.com/runtime/serve -> click 'batching' in TOC :confused:

dev-docs-bot: [auto] link-checker found 1 anchor mismatch in /runtime/serve.md (line 142). Suggests broken anchor '#batching-optimizations' -> '#batching'

Sam: Can you paste the exact markdown around that TOC entry?

Maya: sure
```md
- [Batching optimizations](#batching-optimizations)
```

Sam: Ah yup — header in the file is "## Batching" so anchor is `#batching`. Quick fix is to change link text anchor or update header id via frontmatter. I'm swamped, can someone pick it up? :pray:

Priya: I can take — will open a tiny PR to change the link to `(#batching)` and run preview. tagging @ben for CR if that's quick.

Ben: Happy to review, ping me once PR is up. Also leave a short note in PR about why the anchor doesn't match — might be related to the heading sanitizer change from the last docs build.

Olivia: Heads up — previews on staging are failing intermittently because the new mdx-plugins update strips parenthesis in some anchors. If you change the link, make sure the preview build actually regenerates the TOC. If it doesn't, run `yarn docs:clean && yarn docs:build --preview` locally.

Priya: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1426 (small). Description: Fix TOC anchor to match header `## Batching`. Also adds test for anchor in e2e doc smoke.

Ben: Reviewing now. Left one tiny nit (wrap link text in backticks for clarity). LGTM otherwise. :thumbsup:

Maya: thanks! after merge can we run link-checker CI job again? saw the bot spam earlier but worth confirming.

dev-docs-bot: Triggered link-checker on merge. 0 failures on staging after deploy. :white_check_mark:

Sam: Nice — could we add a short note in docs CONTRIBUTING about verifying TOC anchors when renaming headings? saves these tiny PRs.

Priya: added a bullet in PR description; I'll open a follow-up tiny doc tweak after this merges.

Olivia: If anyone hits the mdx plugin issue again ping me — I can revert the plugin change in the preview branch while we triage.

Maya: awesome. closing the loop — thanks all :sparkles:
